question: In a certain code language, RAMP is coded as 3611332. How will DELL be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a1cb7c3e5db90bdbf809148ded2acbe60f99f0f2efb8268be121487c3704fed.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

**First and last letter is multiplied with × 2.**

**Second and third letters remains same.**

RAMP is coded as 3611332.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09ae9ef770b41e5eccd843a77799eb0d5bcfc5f3f913dbee7367b5b7e85ce027.png] 

Similarly,

DELL will be coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55e49d4a317086a3d75537ea3c50da2a7040c2157ad76f6d56c4d9
cdf82fc1f2.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"851224".**
